## 3. Detailed Case Studies & Works

### Project A: TechGear — E-Commerce Web Application
- **Live URL**: https://sunnatillacoder.github.io/Tech-gear/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/SUNNATILLACODER/Tech-gear
- **Architecture**:
  - Engineered with vanilla JavaScript and utility-first Tailwind CSS.
  - Features dynamic REST API product catalog fetching.
  - Implements client-side real-time fuzzy search across titles and categories.
  - Slide-over cart drawer that calculates totals in real time and persists state across page interactions.
  - Light/Dark theme toggle with persisted user preference.

### Project B: 3D Cyber City — WebGL Canvas Experience
- **Live URL**: https://sunnatillasharipov.uz/#projects
- **Architecture**:
  - Implemented using Three.js and WebGL.
  - Employs procedural skyscraper geometry with custom emissive material properties.
  - Quadratic Bezier curves calculate live traveling data packets between buildings.
  - ACES Filmic tone mapping and exponential fog create high-contrast cyberpunk atmosphere.
  - Locked 60 FPS performance maintained via optimized geometry and passive event listeners.
